newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Nikkei rallies to a strong close.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Nikkei rallies to a strong close.

text.p: SIMEX Nikkei futures rallied to a strong close on monday, boosted by renewed buying in the cash market, dealers said.
"The market is following Wall Street and the cash market, where investors are buying back some key stocks and laggards in the banking, construction and transport sectors," a Japanese dealer said.

Robust pension fund purchases lifted the cash market in Tokyo, dealers said. After trading within a narrow 145-point range for the bulk of the day, the Nikkei 225 June contract ended at 18,590, up 215 points. Turnover was an active 13,245
Dealers said 18,600 proved a strong resistance but expected it to be tested again.
They said early reiteration of Japan's accommodative monetary policy by the Bank of Japan (BOJ) governor Yasuo Matsushita had little impact on the market.
Matsushita was speaking at the opening of a two-day meeting with BOJ branch managers.
The April MSCI Taiwan index contract got a boost from the strong Taiwan cash market to end 4.8 points up, at 349.2, dealers said. -- Angela Tan, Singapore newsroom (65 8703083)
